about_the_game:
HATEFUL CONDUCT: ERR404 is a explosive side-scrolling shooter that knows no mercy and forgives no mistakes. The setting is a corporate headquarters engulfed in chaos, where you are destined to become an instrument of vengeance. You are a mysterious anti-hero, forced to act swiftly and ruthlessly to carve your path to the truth.

Stay one step ahead in seemingly hopeless situations where hordes of enemies seek to destroy you. This digital hell tolerates no hesitation. Every shot here could be your last. Move only forward, fast and decisively, if you want to survive and uncover the secret. Ultra-stylized pixel graphics, a blistering soundtrack, and a chain of surreal events will challenge your reflexes, elevating speed and fury to an absolute level you will never forget.

Key Features:

✔ Deadly Sprint: Don't stop for a second! Plow through crowds of enemies to an insane soundtrack.

✔ Soundtrack for Slaughter: Aggressive compositions that set a frenetic pace for the carnage and give you no respite.

✔ Surreal Story that will make you question the reality of what's happening. Why do you crave this chaos so much?

✔ Arsenal of Chaos: Master a variety of weapons—everything you need for total destruction.

✔ Digital Aesthetic: Thousands of detailed pixel sprites create a unique, stunning, and brutal world where every enemy takedown is a spectacle.

✔ No Mercy: Brutal black humor and a challenge that will test your skills to the limit.

No one will hide. No one will escape.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content that is not appropriate for all ages or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: profanity, violence, black humor.
